page.overview:
Who is Mr. de Rochefort?

Mr. de Rochefort is a minor character in the Tekken series. He is a member of the De Rochefort Family, Lili's father, and a wealthy oil magnate living in Monaco. He is the founder of Rochefort Enterprises.

Mr. de Rochefort is an oil magnate whose company, Rochefort Enterprises, had been in partnership with the Mishima Zaibatsu for many years. He is a pacifist, and was angry and disappointed with his daughter when she ran off to attend the Fifth King of Iron Fist Tournament. When she returned, he grounded Lili for fighting in the tournament. Shortly afterwards however, Jin Kazama ascended to the position of CEO of the Mishima Zaibatsu, and as part of his expansion and declaration of war, took over the oil fields of Rochefort Enterprises. The stress of this situation caused Mr. de Rochefort to collapse, inspiring Lili to seek vengeance against Jin and to try and regain her family's property and restore her father's mental health.

Mr. de Rochefort cares greatly for his daughter, but disapproves of her love of fighting. Whilst he is disappointed in Lili for fighting and grounds her, he also seems to spoil her with gifts like a large tanker and expensive cars, and is unable to stop Lili from doing as she pleases. He seems to have a sensitive side, as the stress of the corporate takeover of his company caused him to collapse. However, he also seems to have personal resilience that Lili admires, since she remarks at one point "I won't give up. I am my father's daughter after all".

Little is known about Mr. de Rochefort's appearance, other than a remark by Lili that Ganryu has "robust eyebrows" like him.
